home.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
home.faq.install.q: Do we need to install software?
home.faq.install.a: No. EduManage Africa opens in the browser and can be installed on a phone like an app, without the Play Store or the App Store.
home.faq.offline.q: What happens when the network is down?
home.faq.offline.a: The app still opens. Families can see information they already viewed; saving happens once the connection is back.
home.faq.security.a: Yes. Each school has its own isolated space, and each team member only accesses the modules their role allows.
home.faq.parents.q: How do parents join the platform?
home.faq.parents.a: The school sends them an activation code from the student's record. They create an account on the family portal and enter that code.
home.faq.help.a: The user guide explains each module step by step. Once logged in, the Support menu lets you write to the DBS Africa team.
